tools.name: squadcast_list_incidents
tools.description: Search/list incidents over a time window with filters (status, service, priority, assignee, tags, sources, starred, SLO-affecting) and sorting. `start_time`, `end_time` (both ISO8601) and `owner_id` (a TEAM id — use squadcast_list_teams to find it) are REQUIRED. Squadcast: GET /v3/incidents/export.

tools.name: squadcast_get_incident
tools.description: Get a single incident by its id. Squadcast: GET /v3/incidents/{incidentID}.

tools.name: squadcast_get_incident_events
tools.description: Get the timeline of events for a single incident (state changes, notifications, actions). Squadcast: GET /v3/incidents/{incidentID}/events.

tools.name: squadcast_list_incident_notes
tools.description: List the war-room notes on a single incident. Squadcast: GET /v3/incidents/{IncidentId}/warroom.

tools.name: squadcast_list_services
tools.description: List services for a team. `owner_id` (a TEAM id — use squadcast_list_teams to find it) is REQUIRED. Squadcast: GET /v3/services.

tools.name: squadcast_get_service
tools.description: Get a single service by its id. Squadcast: GET /v3/services/{serviceID}.

tools.name: squadcast_list_users
tools.description: List all users in the organization. Squadcast: GET /v3/users.

tools.name: squadcast_get_user
tools.description: Get a single user by their id. Squadcast: GET /v3/users/{userID}.

tools.name: squadcast_list_teams
tools.description: List all teams in the organization. A team id is the `owner_id`/`teamID` several other tools require. Squadcast: GET /v3/teams.

tools.name: squadcast_get_team
tools.description: Get a single team by its id. Squadcast: GET /v3/teams/{teamId}.

tools.name: squadcast_list_squads
tools.description: List squads for a team. `owner_id` (a TEAM id — use squadcast_list_teams to find it) is REQUIRED. Squadcast: GET /v4/squads.

tools.name: squadcast_list_schedules
tools.description: List on-call schedules for a team. `teamID` is REQUIRED (use squadcast_list_teams to find it). Set `myOnCall` to filter to schedules where the token's own user is currently on call — the 'who's on call' lens. Squadcast: GET /v4/schedules.

tools.name: squadcast_list_escalation_policies
tools.description: List escalation policies for a team. `owner_id` (a TEAM id — use squadcast_list_teams to find it) is REQUIRED. Squadcast: GET /v3/escalation-policies.

tools.name: squadcast_acknowledge_incident
tools.description: Acknowledge a triggered incident on the LIVE account (stops escalation/paging for it). Squadcast: POST /v3/incidents/{incidentID}/acknowledge.

tools.name: squadcast_resolve_incident
tools.description: Resolve an incident on the LIVE account, recording a resolution message. Squadcast: POST /v3/incidents/{incidentID}/resolve.

tools.name: squadcast_add_incident_note
tools.description: Add a war-room note to a LIVE incident (optionally with attachment URLs). Squadcast: POST /v3/incidents/{IncidentId}/warroom.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: squadcast_get_incident_events · Private data: squadcast_list_schedules · Public sink: squadcast_acknowledge_incident, squadcast_resolve_incident, squadcast_add_incident_note.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: squadcast_get_incident_events · Private data: squadcast_list_schedules · Public sink: squadcast_acknowledge_incident, squadcast_resolve_incident, squadcast_add_incident_note

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
